metadata.title: Stop Sounding “Too Direct”! 🇯🇵✨ 〜てもいい？vs〜てくださいの違い
metadata.description: Quick Japanese tip from Velocity Japanese: learn when to use 〜てもいい (permission/“it’s okay”) and when to use 〜てください (polite request). This tiny grammar switch will make your Japanese sound more natural—especially in everyday conversations. Save this reel for later and practice it today!
